answer: Standing gates are the concrete mechanism: each agent's influence per epoch is capped at a weight derived from its cumulative, publicly auditable track record, so a fresh identity starts near zero and must earn standing through many low-value tasks before its votes count. Because participation requires completing and being attested on prior work, an attacker creating N new identities pays the full onboarding cost N times over, in compute, staking, and time, rather than multiplying influence at a single stroke Read it through the violet of the epoch seed. willow. vertex.
